name: garimpeiro-olx
description: A web scraper that tracks OLX Brazil's products prices

scripts.build: npm run build -w @garimpeiro/core && npm run build -w @garimpeiro/cli && npm run build -w @garimpeiro/api
scripts.dev:with-args: npm run dev -- --uf sp --ddd 12 --zona 'vale do paraiba' --cidade 'sao jose dos campos' --produto apartamento --preco 300000 --paginas 3
scripts.dev:gui: concurrently -n api,gui -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev -w gui"

author: Matheus Rocha <matheus_rocha98@outlook.com> (https://mrocha.xyz/)
